hypothesis: For the same engineering topic, a proof-first opening line earns a higher link-click rate per impression than a generic announcement opening.

stopping_rule.description: Read out once, after 8 pairs or at window end. No peeking-based early stop on a favourable result.

confounders_acknowledged.account_baseline: Both arms of a pair use the same account in the same week.
confounders_acknowledged.time: Both arms use the same Tue@10:00 Europe/Rome slot in consecutive weeks; weekday and holiday drift remain.
confounders_acknowledged.topic: Each pair shares one topic; topics differ between pairs.
confounders_acknowledged.platform: Bluesky only; results do not transfer to other platforms.
confounders_acknowledged.follower_count: Record follower count at each send; growth during the window is a known confounder.
confounders_acknowledged.feed_changes: Feed ranking can change mid-window; note any announced change and do not pool across it.

variants.text: New post on the ReachWeaver project. We wrote up how a local outbox records approvals before anything is sent, and why an uncertain send waits for a human. Review the design: https://github.com/MSKazemi/reachweaver

An interrupted send in ReachWeaver is never retried automatically: it stops in needs_review until a person reconciles it. The outbox keeps that state locally, next to each approval. Review the design: https://github.com/MSKazemi/reachweaver

notes: Illustrative plan. Replace the cohort with your own account and write real, distinct posts. Registration is not approval to publish.
